<user_query>
Compare the UML thesis paper in /Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/paper/ (main.tex and related) against the CURRENT implementation in /Users/dslc/Desktop/UML for fidelity to "UML generation from requirements" paper design.

Return a concise alignment table with columns: Paper claim | Repo status (MATCH / PARTIAL / ADVANCE / GAP) | Evidence (file paths) | Notes.

Cover at least:
1. Three-stage pipeline (spec → PlantUML → render+VLM)
2. Stage-1 model role (LLaMA 3.2-1B) and JSON vs prose/structured spec
3. Stage-2 DeepSeek-R1 / CoT PlantUML for class/object/component/package
4. PlantUML render gate → score 0 on failure
5. Three VLMs + MMMU weights 53.1/50.7/39.9
6. Majority vote τ=4 and dataset filter S≥3.0
7. Four scoring criteria
8. Four diagram types (class, object, component, package)
9. ~8000 sample / dataset workflow
10. Human evaluation support
11. Any ADVANCES beyond paper (source-code input, flowchart, LoRA, dual Ollama, fidelity gate, Streamlit/API, script-without-types handling)

Be accurate to current code (app/services/orchestration.py, scoring.py, spec_json.py, plantuml_from_spec.py, prompts/, config.yaml, settings).
</user_query>
I'll compare the thesis paper against the current UML generation implementation and build a fidelity alignment table.

input.final_summary: Core paper design is implemented (3-stage pipeline, MMMU weights, τ=4 / S≥3.0, render→S=0). Main gaps: Stage-2 often uses deterministic builders instead of DeepSeek+CoT, VLM/human criteria are joint or 1–5 not per-criterion 0–6, and the 8k corpus is HF-assembled rather than paper-style generated. Advances include source-code input, flowchart, LoRA, dual Ollama, fidelity gate, and Streamlit/API.

content.text:
Paper design vs current repo (`paper/main.tex` ↔ `app/services/*`, `config.yaml`, `app/settings.py`, `prompts/`):

| Paper claim | Repo status | Evidence | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1. Three-stage pipeline** (req → JSON spec → PlantUML → render+VLM) | **MATCH** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/orchestration.py` (`generate_technical_spec` → `generate_plantuml_code` → `render_plantuml` → `score_image` / `verify_scores`) | End-to-end path matches paper Fig./§III. Extra repair + template fallbacks sit around Stage 2–3. |
| **2. Stage-1 = LLaMA 3.2-1B → structured JSON** (JSON sole Stage-2 input) | **PARTIAL** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/settings.py` (`spec_model`); `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/prompts/requirement_to_tech_spec.v1.txt`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/spec_json.py` | Default model id matches paper. Spec is validated JSON + derived prose; Stage-2 prompts get **prose**, not raw JSON-only. Default runtime often **mock**, not live LLaMA. |
| **3. Stage-2 = DeepSeek-R1-32B + CoT `<think>` for class/object/component/package** | **PARTIAL** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/settings.py` (`code_model`, `enable_cot`); `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/cot.py`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/prompts/tech_spec_to_{class,object,component,package}.v1.txt`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/orchestration.py` | Model + CoT configured, but object/component/package(/flowchart) often take **`plantuml_from_spec` / template** path, bypassing DeepSeek+CoT. |
| **4. PlantUML render gate → composite S=0 on failure; skip VLM queue** | **MATCH** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/orchestration.py` (failed render → `verify_scores(..., render_ok=False)`); `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/scoring.py` (`paper_composite`) | Matches Eq. δ/S. Repo also repairs / safe-templates before giving up (softens failure rate vs paper narrative). |
| **5. Three VLMs + MMMU weights 53.1 / 50.7 / 39.9** | **MATCH** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/config.yaml`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/settings.py` (`vlm_models`, `weight_*`); `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/providers/factory.py` (`build_vlm_providers`) | Qwen2.5-VL-3B, LLaMA-3.2-Vision-11B, Aya-Vision-8B with paper weights. |
| **6. Majority vote τ=4 (≥2/3) and dataset filter A=1 ∧ S≥3.0** | **MATCH** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/scoring.py` (`majority_vote_accept`, `dataset_entry_accepted`); `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/settings.py` (`acceptance_tau=4.0`, `min_composite_for_dataset=3.0`) | Faithful to paper Eqs. (vote)/(majority) + dataset rule. |
| **7. Four scoring criteria** (semantic / structural / syntactic / coherence) on **0–6** | **PARTIAL** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/prompts/vlm_scoring.v1.txt`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/ui/pages/5_Human_Evaluation.py`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/prompts/human_evaluation_rubric.v1.txt`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/models.py` (`HumanReview` 1–5) | Criteria named in VLM prompt, but one **joint** SCORE 0–6 (not 4 numeric scores). Human UI/API uses **1–5**, not paper’s 0–6. |
| **8. Four diagram types** (class, object, component, package) | **ADVANCE** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/config.yaml` (`diagram_types`); `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/prompts_registry.py` | Paper’s four present; **flowchart** added as 5th type. |
| **9. ~8000-sample / dataset workflow** (4 domains × 500 × 4 types via pipeline) | **PARTIAL** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/build_training_corpus.py`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/config.yaml` (`samples_per_type: 2000`); `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/generate_dataset.py` | Target/size tooling exists, but 8k is mainly **HF corpus assembly**, not paper’s live 4-domain generation. App `generate_dataset.py` is a small demo (default ~200). |
| **10. Human evaluation support** (same rubric; correlate with VLM) | **PARTIAL** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/ui/pages/5_Human_Evaluation.py`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/routers/human_review.py`; analytics UI | Rubric + persist reviews exists; scale mismatch (1–5 vs 0–6); no built-in stratified n=40 / seed=42 protocol from paper §IV. |
| **11a. Source-code → Stage-1** | **ADVANCE** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/code_analysis.py`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/prompts/code_to_tech_spec.v1.txt`; `orchestration.generate_technical_spec` | Not in paper (NL requirements only). |
| **11b. Flowchart type** | **ADVANCE** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/prompts/tech_spec_to_flowchart.v1.txt`; `plantuml_from_spec.build_flowchart_plantuml` | Beyond paper’s four UML families. |
| **11c. LoRA fine-tuned PlantUML generator** | **ADVANCE** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/providers/finetuned_provider.py`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/scripts/finetune_plantuml.py`; settings `use_finetuned_code` | Optional Stage-2 path; skipped for package/flowchart. |
| **11d. Dual Ollama** (Vision vs Qwen-VL ports) | **ADVANCE** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/settings.py` (`ollama_base_url`, `ollama_qwen_base_url`); `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/providers/factory.py` | Deployment convenience, not paper. |
| **11e. Spec↔PlantUML fidelity gate** | **ADVANCE** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/plantuml_from_spec.py` (`fidelity_report`, `ensure_faithful_plantuml`) | Replaces weak LLM UML with deterministic builder when recall/coverage fails. |
| **11f. Streamlit UI + FastAPI** | **ADVANCE** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/ui/`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/main.py`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/routers/` | Paper is method/dataset; app is productized. |
| **11g. `script_without_types` handling** | **ADVANCE** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/spec_json.py`; `orchestration.run_single_generation` (redirect class/object → flowchart) | Avoids fake classes from scripts with no type decls. |
| **11h. Repair loop + typed validators** | **ADVANCE** | `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/repair.py`; `/Users/dslc/Desktop/UML/app/services/plantuml_validate.py` | Paper: fail → S=0; repo: validate/repair before scoring. |

**Bottom line:** Scoring math, VLM ensemble weights, τ/S gates, render→0, and the three-stage shape are **paper-faithful**. Biggest fidelity gaps are Stage-2 often not DeepSeek+CoT (deterministic/spec-builder), criteria not scored as four separate 0–6 dimensions (human 1–5), and the 8k workflow not reproducing the paper’s domain×spec generation process.
